description: Source code for Electron integration in Playwright, defining classes for Electron and ElectronApplication, including methods for launching, managing windows, evaluating scripts, and event handling.

classes.name: Electron
classes.description: Represents the Electron launcher, capable of launching Electron applications with specific options.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Represents a running Electron application, managing windows, events, and script evaluation.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an Electron application with specified options.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to get an Electron instance from a channel object.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Returns the child process associated with the Electron application.

methods.name: _onPage
methods.description: Internal method to handle new pages (windows) in the Electron app.

methods.name: windows
methods.description: Returns an array of current window pages.

methods.name: firstWindow
methods.description: Returns the first window, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: context
methods.description: Returns the browser context associated with the Electron app.

methods.name: [Symbol.asyncDispose]
methods.description: Asynchronous disposal method to close the Electron app.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event with optional predicate and timeout.

methods.name: browserWindow
methods.description: Gets a handle to the BrowserWindow object for a specific page.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function or expression in the context of the Electron app.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function or expression and returns a handle.
